title: Sale of dcg holograms at MIT ?

posts.topic_title: Sale of dcg holograms at MIT ?
posts.author: dave battin
posts.post_subject: Sale of dcg holograms at MIT ?
posts.content_md:
Hello All, i received good feedback from Seth Riskin about selling my DCG holograms, and it got me thinking about a few things, and i thought some of the forum members might like to be involved as well. 

here is my idea #1

 if any member can produce a nice GREEN silver reflection master (for proximity copying in dcg) ,@4x5 0r larger, and send it to me, i can produce copies in dcg for the possibility of selling them in the MIT store. If this image is sales worthy then royalties will be paid out, how much that is will be determined later. 

 Idea # 2

any holographer doing DCG is to produce a minimum one image, be able to make repeatable copies of this image and make it in a uniform way, like 5"x5" with edges ground round (or i can grind/polish them here),i would/could make nice minimalist wood bases for all, with the possibility of having the front of these wood bases engraved with MIT logo, Name on back ?

who would like to do this ? ill be talking to Seth shortly and would like to know if there is any intrest here as i can include them to submit along with mine when i get to boston (hopfully).

I need a shipping address.

Ron
